aboutIntro: Keyboard shortcuts, tutorials, community and more to help you learn and grow HAX.
haxDescription: HAX is a web-native authoring system designed for accessible, modular content publishing across many delivery environments.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Registered centrally in HAXcms and shown by active context. Bindings use Ctrl+Shift+[Key]; in the editor, typing a markdown trigger then space converts the block. Type {slash} in an empty text block to open inline Search.
tutorialsDescription: Start with guided tasks, then move to step-by-step tutorials.
apiLinksDescription: HAXcms can publish pages in machine-friendly formats so LLM tools can read and process your content with less cleanup.
apiLinksFormats: Add {formats} to page URLs to request alternate page outputs.
apiLinksLlms: Use {llms} as a model-facing index for this site, with links to key machine-readable resources.
apiLinksPair: Pair {siteJson} (structure) with {searchIndex} (retrieval) for stronger AI-powered workflows.
apiLinksOpenapi: Explore the site API contract at {openapi}.
